Dry-type bleeding

### A Caution:

– The filling pressure of the brake fluid filling device is 2 bar. Do not increase the pressure; otherwise the brake fluid reservoir may be damaged!
Bleeding must be carried out as per the specified sequence; otherwise, bleeding is required again.
During bleeding, do not exit the VDS bleeding operation interface; otherwise, bleeding is required again.
VDS battery must be kept sufficient during bleeding.
During bleeding calibration, the brake pedal surface will push against the foot. In this case, the driver can stabilize the pedal, and it is forbidden to press the pedal firmly.
When the bleeding calibration is terminated by ECU, please restart this round of bleeding; in case of failure for multiple times, please wait for 2 min in the failure interface and then restart this round of bleeding.
After successful bleeding, the instrument panel cluster shall have no ABS, ESC or brake system alarm, and the process of pressing the brake pedal shall be normal without any abnormal sound.

1. Power on the vehicle.

![](images/0bd367a14a62998effacb8e823517e3cd3ef71b6500eb3042802a8c9127552d8.webp)

f. Select "Calibration". g. Select "Installation mode" for calibration.

3. Connect the brake fluid collection container with the bleed screw via a clean and transparent exhaust hose. 4. Connect the brake fluid pressurizing equipment, and make sure that the equipment and the brake fluid reservoir opening are well sealed and firmly fixed

without leakage. Turn on the brake fluid pressurizing equipment and increase the pressure to 2 bar.

![](images/78fc107182c0763015d756e7c773702eb29e90f4ca01a06a054c776cb80ff58f.webp)

5. Enter the "Dry-type bleeding" operation interface via the VDS for guidance.

### ? Caution:

The operations must be performed in the specified air discharge sequence, otherwise air discharge must be
restarted.
When releasing the bleed screw and stepping on the brake pedal to exhaust, the drive must keep the pedal in the
current state rather than depressing it forcibly in case of bulge of the pedal
surface.
If there are still bubbles in the brake fluid coming out of the exhaust hose, repeat the operation until there is no bubble.

### A Caution:

The EPB maintenance process must
be performed by professionals with
professional training. Original factory parts and components must be used for
replacements.
Replacement of EPB must be carried out in a professional authorized service shop with lifting equipment.
When the vehicle is running, it is
prohibited to operate the EPB switch unless emergency braking is required.
Anyone who is not familiar with the EPB must not operate it to prevent accidents.

### Systems Manual

Overview

Electronic parking brake system (EPB) controls parking brake through electronic circuit. The function is the same as the mechanical hand brake. You may not manually turn off the electrical park brake for starting, the electrical park brake will automatically turn off when you depress the accelerator to start.

System function

Dynamic function: When driving, if the pedal is not depressed to brake, the braking function is realized by pressing and holding the EPB button.

Driving release function: when the driver is driving and the accelerator pedal is depressed, the parking will be released automatically after engaging the gear.

Emergency release function: when the electronic parking is powered off and needs to be released, the parking can be released with a specialized release tool.

### A Caution:

After release in the maintenance mode as per method 1 and method 2 as below,
all the functions of the EPB will be
disabled to avoid damage of the EPB drive assembly due to accidental actions during maintenance.
After the maintenance is completed and the vehicle state is recovered, the EPB can return to the normal state only when the state of release in the maintenance mode is deactivated.

### Method 1

1. Connect the VDS to the DLC.

![](images/a2a68deb1fc8f30547bc9b10cac66a950293e8f0d4cf047975d52c41da8f532a.webp)

2. Power on the vehicle and wait until its selftest ends.
3. After the VDS establishes communication with the vehicle, click "Diagnostic system".
4. Select "Passenger car".
5. Select the corresponding vehicle series and model to scan.
6. Select the "EPB" module.
7. Select "Action test".
8. Select "Maintenance mode release".

Method 2

A Caution:

The brake pedal must be depressed in the whole process;

### ? Caution:

If the switch is held for less than 10 s or more than 12 s when being pressed down for the first time, the system will return to the initial state automatically and must be operated again;
If the switch is pressed down again within 3 s or 5 s after being released for the first time, the system will return to the initial
state automatically and must be operated again;
After activating the full release state, the system will not respond to any function. In this case, it is necessary to select “Pullup in maintenance mode” or use the EPB switch to deactivate the state of release in the maintenance mode.

1. Power on the vehicle or start it.

2. Press and hold the brake pedal.
3. Press and hold the EPB switch for more than 10 s, and the brake warning indicator on the instrument panel will flash.
4. Release the EPB switch within 2 s after the warning indicator starts flashing.
5. Start timing after the EPB switch is released and press the EPB switch again within the subsequent 3 \~ 5 s.
6. Completely release the EPB, and the warning indicator turns to illuminate constantly.
7. Release the brake pedal.

### Method 3

If the above two methods fail due to electrical equipment fault, mechanica service release can be carried out as follows:

1. Remove the wheeled EPB motor drive assembly. Refer to
2. Use a tool to release the brake piston by rotating the spline on the caliper body clockwise, and release the brake piston until the thrust screw of the caliper body rotates freely.

EPB maintenance mode release exit

### A Caution:

After release of EPB in the maintenance mode, only the state of release in the
maintenance mode is deactivated, can the EPB return to the normal state and respond to all functions.
Once the EPB drive assembly is removed from the vehicle, it is forbidden to power on the vehicle for drive.

### Method 1

1. Connect the VDS to the DLC.

![](images/62af2d5e72944b3a38bc0e2e88eb8eb9e44690a6e1a683180bec240fcf4617e9.webp)

2. Power on the vehicle and wait until its selftest ends.
3. After the VDS establishes communication with the vehicle, click "Diagnostic system".
4. Select "Passenger car".
5. Select the corresponding vehicle series and model to scan.
6. Select the "EPB" module.
7. Select "Action test".
8. Select "Service clamping".

Method 2

### A Caution:

The brake pedal must be depressed in the whole process;
The switch must be held for more than 10 s when being pressed down for the first time, otherwise the system will return to the initial state;

### A Caution:

The switch must be pressed down again within 5 s after being released for the first time, otherwise the system will return to the initial state; After the state of release in the maintenance mode is deactivated with the switch, the EPB returns to the normal state and can respond to all functions.

1. Power on the vehicle or start it.

2. Press and hold the brake pedal.

3. Press and hold the EPB switch for more than 10 s, and the brake warning indicator on the instrument panel will flash.
4. Release the EPB switch and pull it up again within the subsequent 5 s.
5. With the EPB pulled up, the warning indicator will go out, and the EPB status light will illuminate.

6. Release the brake pedal.

### A Caution:

The brake fluid has a strong corrosive effect on the paint. If it is accidentally splashed on the paint of the vehicle body, it must be cleaned with a rag as soon as possible. Avoid oil contact with skin. If it is accidentally splashed into the eyes, immediately rinse with plenty of water and seek medical attention as soon as possible. Do not discharge the oil at will, and recycle it according to local regulations.

### Systems Manual

Overview

The front and rear brakes on this model are disc brakes. It is controlled by hydraulic pressure, the main parts include brake discs, brake calipers, brake pads, brake mudguards and brake oil pipes.

The front brake is composed of the following components:

Brake disc
The friction force of the brake pad acts on the brake disc to reduce the rotation speed of the wheel.

Brake caliper

The brake disc is a device to make moving wheels decelerate, stop, or remain stationary.

Brake pad

The friction from the brake caliper acts on the friction surface of the brake disc.

Front brake mudguard

It is mainly used to block the sand and dirt from the outside to protect the normal operation of the brake.

Brake fluid pipe

Ensure that the braking force is transmitted to the brake caliper of the vehicle, the braking medium is transmitted during braking and the braking force is released effectively at any time.

### A Caution:

The brake pad comprises substances that meet the Chinese standard, but it will be harmful to health if their dust is inhaled frequently. – It is required to use the vacuum cleaner to clean the brake assembly, instead of a suction hose or brush.

1. Remove the front brake pad assembly. Refer to Installation and Removal of Front Brake Pad Assembly

![](images/7b8019470348f92020629d5228d7c4b924d51d73bc56f22c6086848adb7b0baa.webp)

2. Check the thickness of brake pad.

Thickness of brake pad: Standard: 8.0 mm Service limit: 2.0 mm

A Caution:

If the thickness of brake pad is less than the service limit, replace the whole set of brake pad.

### Inspection of front brake disc End face runout

1. Remove the front brake pad assembly. Refer to Installation and Removal of Front Brake Pad Assembly

2. Check whether the brake disc surface is damaged or cracked, thoroughly clean the brake disc and remove all rust.

![](images/60d16e4c66925c64e28113807ff482689dac3e8ed52aff81bddee1d280cdd91c.webp)

3. Install the dial indicator base on the body, and install the dial indicator measuring probe in place so that it is in contact with the friction surface of brake disc at 90° and is 10 mm away from the outer edge of brake disc.

4. Rotate the brake disc until the reading of dial indicator reaches the minimum, and then zero the dial indicator.

5. Rotate the brake disc until the reading of the dial indicator reaches the maximum, make a mark, and record the end face runout.

6. If the end face runout of brake disc exceeds the service limit of 0.08 mm, repair the brake disc with an on-board brake lathe.

Standard thickness of brake disc: 25 mm Maximum service limit of brake disc: 23 mm

### A Caution:

If the brake disc exceeds the service limit, replace it.

1. Remove the front brake pad assembly. Refer to Installation and Removal of Front Brake Pad Assembly

![](images/3834fd89d67cf3ae326bdbe176363982ece36df50ec5970d29b040c7c637f94f.webp)

2. Use a micrometer to measure the thickness of brake disc at 8 points 10 mm away from the outer edge of brake disc and at the intervals of about 45°

Standard thickness of brake disc: 25 mm Maximum service limit of brake disc: 23 mm Parallelism of brake disc: max. 0.05 mm

### Inspection of wheel bearing axial clearance

1. Remove the front wheel assembly. Refer to Installation and Removal of Wheel Assembly

![](images/a401e046e86375164c2fadf96aa472a1dd87b62d38dbf1b3df1931d4eed534a9.webp)

2. Install the dial indicator, set its reading to zero, and measure the axial clearance of the wheel bearing by moving the brake disc axially inward and outward.

Standard axial clearance of front wheel bearing: 0.07-0.10 mm

A Caution:

Replace wheel bearings if the axial clearance of bearings is greater than the standard value.

### A Caution:

Brake fluid has a strong corrosive effect on paint, if accidentally splashed onto the body paint, must be cleaned with a rag as soon as possible.
Be careful to avoid contact with skin. If the oil spills into eyes, rinse immediately with plenty of water and seek medical attention as soon as possible.
Do not discharge the oil randomly, and
recycle it according to local laws and
regulations.

### Systems Manual

Overview

The rear brake consists of the following components:

Brake disc

The friction force of the brake pad acts on the brake disc to reduce the rotation speed of the wheel.

Brake caliper

The brake disc is a device to make moving wheels decelerate, stop, or remain stationary.

Brake pad

The friction from the brake caliper acts on the friction surface of the brake disc.

Front brake mudguard

It is mainly used to block the sand and dirt from the outside to protect the normal operation of the brake.

Brake fluid pipe

Ensure that the braking force is transmitted to the brake caliper of the vehicle, the braking medium is transmitted during braking and the braking force is released effectively at any time.

Wheeled EPB motor drive assembly

EPB is called electronic parking brake system, and controls the parking brake through the electronic circuit, with function as the same as mechanical hand brake. When starting, it is unnecessary to manually close the electrical park brake. When depressing the accelerator to start, the electrical park brake will automatically close.

### Reminder:

The brake pad is composed of toxic substances, so frequent inhalation of its dust will be harmful to your health.

Avoid inhaling brake pad dust.
Be sure to use the vacuum cleaner to clean the brake assembly, instead of a suction hose or brush.

1. Remove the rear brake pad assembly. Refer to Installation and Removal of Rear Brake Pad Assembly

![](images/5618e6c85a643df5ece63a449473e2701d27d007585fc483faab428af6425ce4.webp)

2. Check the thickness of inner and outer brake pads.

Standard: 6.5 mm Service limit: 2 mm

3. If the thickness of brake pad is less than the service limit, replace the whole set of brake pad.

### Inspection of rear brake disc Test

1. Vibration

a. Remove the rear brake pad assembly. Refer to Installation and Removal of Rear Brake Pad Assembly

b. Check the brake disc surface for damage or cracking. Thoroughly clean the brake disc and remove all rust.

c. Install appropriate flat washers and wheel nuts. Tighten the nut to the specified torque.

Tightening torque: 120±5 N•m d. Place the dial indicator against the brake disc, measure the vibration at 10 mm from the outer edge of the brake disc, and rotate the brake disc to observe the reading of the dial indicator pointer.

![](images/253b44382753901d15602197cebe5283cbeab57a7b5af439c9e47872a8a95a8c.webp)

e. If the brake disc vibration exceeds the service limit of 0.08 mm, repair the brake disc with an on-board brake lathe.

Maximum service limit of rear brake disc: 7 mm

f. f the brake disc exceeds the service limit, replace it.

2. Thickness

![](images/1109d737efc24e71ecdb92fab84046d988a237ae758df644f3c66658af8333ea.webp)

a. Use a micrometer to measure the thickness of the brake disc at 8 points 10 mm away from the outer edge of the brake disc and at the intervals of about 45° If the minimum measured value is less than the maximum service limit, replace the brake disc.

![](images/64a500113199933812b07402939de2b02b723845722c3f869273b2e159ceffb7.webp)

![](images/52b2adb26df27e6b785efe143ef6507998df9b00fb1c68643cd006c942abf106.webp)

? Caution:

This is the maximum allowable deviation from the thickness measurement.

b. If the minimum measured value is less than the maximum service limit, replace the brake disc.
c. If the parallelism of the brake disc exceeds the service limit, repair the brake disc with an on-board brake lathe.

A Caution:

If the parallelism of the brake disc exceeds the re-service limit, replace the brake disc.

### Inspection of wheel bearing axial clearance

1. Remove the rear wheel assembly. Refer to Installation and Removal of Wheel Assembly

![](images/2fd004064993c6290a492d51e5a683ff090f0ac38352ccb6b3d7f5d954abf1ae.webp)

2. Install the dial indicator, set its reading to zero, and measure the axial clearance of the wheel bearing by moving the brake disc axially inward and outward.

Standard axial clearance of rear wheel bearing: -0.01-0.04 mm

A Caution:

Replace wheel bearings if the axial clearance of bearings is greater than the standard value.

After installation, road test must be carried out to check whether the braking system can work normally and whether there is any abnormality.

### System descriptions Overview

The EPS (Electric Power-assistant Steering) system is a steering system that uses the steering power provided by an EPS motor to assist a driver in performing steering operations. Like other control systems, this system is composed of sensors (torque and angle sensor, vehicle speed sensor), a controller (EPS electronic control unit), an actuator (EPS motor) and relevant mechanical components.

The EPS system, designed based on a mechanical steering system, features the latest electronic technology and high-performance motor control technology. Based on the original vehicle steering system, the EPS is modified and added with the following parts: EPS electronic control unit, torque and angle sensor, EPS motor, etc. The motor-driven transmission mechanism of the system replaces the traditional mechanical hydraulic mechanism, and can provide real-time steering wheel power for the driver in various environments.

The EPS system is powered by the EPS motor, and the power level is adjusted and controlled in real time by the EPS electronic control unit. The system provides different power according to different vehicle speeds, to improve the steering performance of vehicle, reduce the control force during parking and low-speed driving, and improve the stability of steering control during high-speed driving, thus improving the active safety of vehicle.

Main system components

Torque and angle sensor Vehicle speed sensor EPS electronic control unit EPS motor Related mechanica structure

Main system components

1. Power-assistant control function

The EPS system provides speedsensitive power assistance. This means that with the same steering wheel torque input, the target motor current changes with the vehicle speed, so as to better meet easy steering and road feel requirements. Its

power assistance is also segmented: The EPS motor applies power-assistant torque according to the steering wheel deviation direction, which ensures easy steering at low speed and stable operation at high speed for good road feel.

### 2. Return-to-center (RTC) control function

During steering, the steering wheel can automatically return to center by virtue of its king pin caster angle and king pin inclination angle. Based on the mechanical steering mechanism, an EPS motor and speed reduction mechanism are added for the EPS system. The EPS system performs steering RTC control of the EPS motor through the EPS electronic control unit, and together with the aligning torque produced by front wheel alignment, implements the steering RTC action. This allows the steering wheel to quickly return to center, inhibits its vibration, maintains good road feel, increases steering sensitivity and stability, optimizes the steering RTC performance and shortens the convergence time. The RTC control is implemented by adjusting the RTC compensation current, which produces a

RTC torque to cause the steering wheel to return to center along a direction.

### 3. Damping control function

When the vehicle runs at a high speed, damping control is completed by controlling the damping compensation current to enhance the road feel and improve the steering stability under high-speed running.

System working principle

When the vehicle makes a turn, the torque and angle sensor detects the size and direction of the torque and angle, and processes and passes the size and direction signals to the EPS electronic control unit. The EPS electronic control unit receives vehicle speed signals detected by the vehicle speed sensor at the same time, and determines the motor rotation direction and power-assistant torque based on signals of the vehicle speed sensor and the torque and angle sensor. At the same time, the current sensor detects the current of the circuit and monitors the drive circuit which finally drives the motor to work for power-assistant steering.

4. Remove the lower right shield assembly of instrument panel. Refer to Removal and installation of lower right shield assembly of instrument panel
5. Remove 2 fixing screws and take out the lower right reinforcement plate of instrument panel.

![](images/6837d5eecc3fd11a8e7d9518ced7cd504693beafb04882057861a9925b8d470b.webp)

### A Caution:

Remove it with the assistance of another maintenance technician to prevent injury caused by sudden falling.

### A Caution:

When installing the steering column and steering gear bolts, screw them in from the unthreaded side. Screwing in from the other side will lead to poor tightening, or even an accident. The side of the universal joint yoke without threads has a milled plane. Screw in bolts from this side.
After replacing the EPS column & universal joint assembly, use a VDS to calibrate the new one.

1. Install it in the reverse order of removal.

### A Caution:

The EPS system has an active return-to-center control function and remote driving function. After any part of the steering system (including EPS column assembly, countershaft assembly, mechanical steering gear assembly, and EPS electronic control unit assembly) is removed and replaced, four-wheel alignment should be performed, with the steering angle signals calibrated and at the same time with the ESP steering angle signals calibrated.

![](images/c5f10fa324ec125318a04355487424a8f3834271e2db3eb0d62182fcbd13554a.webp)

1. Connect the VDS and enter the diagnostic system interface.

2. Select the vehicle model.
3. Power steering.
4. Steering angle zero calibration.
5. Calibration succeeded.

### A Caution:

When removing the mechanical steering gear with tie rod assembly, check the dust cover for cracks or damages, and replace it with a new one.

After installation, wheel alignment must be carried out. When adjusting the four wheel alignment, observe the exposed amount of the left and right tie rod threads, and try to make the exposed amount of the left and right tie rods the same. After the four wheel alignment, tighten the tie rod lock nut.

### Systems Manual

Overview

The fender is the outer body covering the wheel. The front fender is installed at the front wheel and must ensure the maximum limit space when the front wheel rotates and bounces.

The function of the fender is to prevent the gravel and mud from splashing onto the underside of the vehicle during driving.

### System descriptions Overview

The bumper beam is used to absorb the collision energy in case of collision. It consists of main beam, energy absorption box and mounting plate connecting the vehicle. Both the main beam and the energy absorption box can effectively absorb the collision energy in the event of low-speed collision, thus minimizing the damage to the longitudinal beam of the vehicle body under the impact force and protecting the vehicle.

The bumper beam is mainly used to reduce the maintenance cost in case of mediumand lowspeed collisions, and can reduce the harm to the driver and passengers to a certain extent.

### System descriptions

The trailer hitch assembly consists of a trailer hitch cross beam assembly and a trailer hitch subassembly. The trailer hitch assembly includes a trailer hitch cross beam, a wiring harness bracket, a trailer hitch connector, an antenna mounting bracket, etc., while the trailer hitch subassembly includes a trailer hitch body, a key, etc.

### Systems Manual

The front windshield, the tailgate glass and other door and window glasses together form a closed driving and riding space. At the same time, they have the function of transmitting light and can provide drivers with a good sense of vision.

Most of the front windshield glass is laminated toughened glass. Even if it is impacted by external force, the glass fragments will stick together, which can protect the drivers and passengers in the car in case of an accident.

![](images/48fd9bea5680bd22a2ddd4257d2d6e6dffc6fcef56ecd0ce3bce218524c19388.webp)

![](images/041ae56ab907c809803a4743cdfb2922d4d5c80c6723eee83fcd6013c92e1934.webp)

### A Caution:

– Must use the manufacturer's recommended glass cement, and misuse of glass cement will affect its own original adhesive property. Carefully read the instructions and designations provided by the manufacturer of the glass adhesive used before operation, and be sure to adopt this procedure and observe all precautions throughout the operation.
If the coating surface is scratched and damaged, repair it or replace it with a new one, otherwise the damaged part will gradually expand. Cover the body and dashboard around the windshield with tape to prevent damage to the
body, dashboard and guard.

1. Remove the ventilation cover assembly. See Installation and Removal of the Ventilation Cover Assembly

2. Remove the left A-pillar upper guard assembly. See Installation and Removal of Left A-Pillar Upper Guard Assembly

4. Remove the inside rearview mirror assembly. See Installation and Removal of Inside Rearview Mirror Assembly

5. Driving recorder camera See Installation and Removal of Driving Recorder Camera

6. Remove the multifunctional video control module. See Installation and Removal of Multifunctional Video Control Module Assembly

7. Humidity sensor. See Installation and Removal of Air Humidity Sensor

A Caution:

The window sealing strip fits the body. To prevent damage to the body surface when pulling a steel wire to cut the
sealant, it is necessary to cut the edge of the sealing strip.
Cover the body with tape to prevent damage to the body.

### A Caution:

Take out with care and with the assistance of another maintenance technician.

A Caution:

Take out with care and with the assistance of another maintenance technician.

1. Remove the adhesive agent remaining on the contact surface between the vehicle body and the glass to ensure that the surface of the vehicle body meets the requirements.

### ? Caution:

Be careful not to damage the body on its paint.
After cleaning, do not touch oil and
water.

2. Apply sufficient base agent around the glass surface to be bonded to the body, with a width of about 15 mm.

3. Stick the front windshield sealing strip to the front windshield glass and apply glass cement evenly to the body and glass installation positions.

4. Align the clip on the inner surface of the glass with the hole on the body and press the glass into the body.

### A Caution:

After installation, make sure that the glass clings to the body completely. If the adhesive tape is not fully attached, press it with tape until the adhesive is completely bonded. If the door is closed suddenly before the adhesive is completely bonded, the glass may become loose or fall off. Do not drive the vehicle before the bonding part is fully bonded to ensure a thorough and sufficient curing.

### A Caution:

Each glass adhesive has its own curing time. Be sure to check the curing time of the used glass adhesive with reference to manufacturer s instruction, and take necessary measures before the bonding part is fully bonded.
Do not use high pressure water gun for waterproof test.
When drying, do not use the
compressed air directly to the glued
part, do not use infrared bulb or the like. After the glass cement is solidified,
the waterproof test shall be carried
out. If water seepage is found, glass
cement shall be used to fill the leakage part. After filling, if leakage can still be found, remove the glass and restart
the installation according to the above installation steps.

### A Caution:

Wear goggles and gloves when handling any glass with sharp edges or burrs to reduce the risk of injury.
The glass cement must be applied evenly and continuously.
When removing the glass assembly, use the glass sucker to remove it.
After the glass assembly is installed,
you must wait until the glass cement is completely cured before driving.

Installation

A Caution:

Be careful not to damage the tailgate assembly on its paint.
After cleaning, do not touch oil and water.

2. Apply sufficient base agent around the glass surface to be bonded to the tailgate assembly with a brush, with a width of about 15 mm.

3. Apply glass cement evenly to the installation position of the tailgate assembly and the glass.

4. Align the clip on the inner surface of the glass with the hole on the tailgate assembly. Press the glass onto the tailgate assembly.

### A Caution:

Ensure that the glass is fully backrest to the door assembly after installation.
– If the adhesive tape is not fully attached, press it with tape until the adhesive is completely bonded.
– If the door is closed suddenly before the adhesive is completely bonded, the glass may become loose or fall off. Do not drive the vehicle before the bonding part is fully bonded to ensure a thorough and sufficient curing. Each glass cement has its own curing time. Do not use high pressure water gun for
waterproof test.
– When drying, do not use the compressed air directly to the glued part, do not use infrared bulb or the like. After the glass cement is solidified, the waterproof test must be carried out. If water seepage is found, glass cement must be used to fill the leakage part. After filling, if leakage can still be found, remove the glass and restart the installation according to the above installation steps.

### ？ Warning:

Before removing the wiper system, low voltage electrical system must be powered off to prevent injury caused by sudden operation of the wiper system.

### A Caution:

Switch the wiper system to the maintenance gear before removing. When removing the wiper arm assembly, pay attention to prevent the front windshield glass from being damaged due to the rebound of the wiper arm assembly. After installation, check whether the wiper arm assembly is in the initial position. After installation, run the front wiper system and check to see if it is working properly.

System descriptions Overview

The wiper system is one of the safety devices in a vehicle. It is designed to clear rain, snow, and dirt from the front windshield, providing a clear driving vision for the driver.

Installation

### A Caution:

While installing the front wiper arm assembly, pay attention to adjusting its installation position, and the wiper blade must be aligned with the locating point under the front windshield glass.

Removal and installation of front wiper left blade assemblyRemoval

1. Open the hood assembly and lift the front left wiper arm.

After taking out the front left wiper blade assembly, wrap the wiper arm in contact with the front windshield glass with cloth and gently lower the wiper arm down to prevent front windshield glass damage due to rebound.

### A Caution:

– When installing the wiper blade inlet wiper arm, you must hear a "click" sound and check whether it is installed in place.
– After installing the wiper blade, gently lower the wiper arm to prevent the front windshield glass from being damaged due to too fast falling.

After taking out the right wiper blade assembly of the front wiper, wrap the area between the wiper arm and the front windshield glass with cloth and gently lay down the wiper arm to prevent the front windshield glass from being damaged due to rebound.

Installation

![](images/9cc8a3adf8216da5f0c564bafe803c15dc647c8c4425017e654efea428e7a7cf.webp)

Tightening torque: 10N·m

### A Caution:

After adjustment, the front compartment cover assembly and front compartment cover lock body assembly shall not interfere with each other.

### A Caution:

When removing and installing the internal parts of the door assembly, wear gloves to prevent against scratches.

Remove the door assembly with the assistance of another maintenance technician.

When removing the door exterior water cut, do not pry the exterior water cut with metal tools to prevent damage to the door paint.

When removing the door glass, lift the glass to the maintenance position in advance and then power off the low voltage system to facilitate the removal and installation of the fixing bolt.

A Caution:

After the door hinge is removed, the position of the door assembly must be adjusted to prevent movement interference from damaging the door.

Check whether the removed sealing plugs are complete and free from damage. Ensure that they are in place during installation to prevent the electrical parts from being damaged and the door from being rusted due to the rainwater entering the door.

Before installing the door guard, check whether all clips are lost or damaged, and replace with new ones if any. After installation, it must fit in place with the door assembly.

When installing the fastener, tighten the fastener to the standard torque.

### Systems Manual Overview

The door is the channel for the drivers and passengers to get in and out of the door, which can not only isolate the external interference,

but also buffer the impact force in case of collision, so as to protect the drivers and passengers.

### Removal and installation of front left door assembly

Caution:

Remove or install the door assembly with the assistance of another maintenance technician.

### Removal

1. Remove the front left door frame trim strip assembly. Refer to Installation and Removal of Left Front Door Trim Strip Assembly
2. Remove the left side mirror assembly. Refer to Installation and Removal of Left Outside Rearview Mirror Assembly
3. Remove the front left door outer handle assembly. Refer to Removal and installation of front left door outer handle assembly
4. Remove the front left door run channel assembly. Refer to Installation and Removal of Left Front Door Window Runchannel Assembly
5. Remove the front left window regulator assembly. Refer to Installation and Removal of Left Front Window Regulator
6. Remove the rear movable guide rail assembly of front left door. Refer to Installation and Removal of Left Front Door Rear Guide Rail Assembly
7. Remove the front left door stopper block. Refer to Installation and Removal of Door Stop Block
8. Remove the front left door brake assembly. Refer to Front Hatch Cover Front Door Stopper Assembly
9. Remove the outer weather strip of front left door. Refer to Installation and Removal of Left Front Door Outer Weatherstrip Assembly
10. Remove the front left door wiring harness. Refer to Removal and installation of front left door wiring harness

![](images/33181f259093c5c2713e7e9c8b59f3fd4e5a3c5ee0baf8bb5d25b950e1119f04.webp)

Installation

11. Remove 2 fixing bolts of the front left door assembly. Tightening torque: 28±2 N•m

12. Remove 2 fixing bolts and take out the front left door assembly.

Tightening torque: 28±2 N•m

1. Install it in the reverse order of removal.

### Removal

1. Remove the right front door trim strip assembly. See Installation and Removal of the Right Front Door Trim Strip Assembly

2. Remove the right outside rearview mirror assembly. See Installation and Removal of Right Outside Rearview Mirror Assembly

3. Remove the right front door lock body assembly. See Installation and Removal of Right Front Door Lock Body Assembly

4. Remove the right front door outer handle assembly. See Installation and Removal of Right Front Door Outside Handle Assembly

5. Remove the right front door window runchannel assembly. See Installation and Removal of Right Front Door Window Runchannel Assembly

6. Remove the right front window regulator assembly. See Installation and Removal of Right Front Window Regulator

7. Remove the right front door rear guide rail assembly. See Installation and Removal of Right Front Door Rear Guide Rail Assembly

8. Remove the right front door limit block. See Installation and Removal of Door Stop Block

9. Remove the right front door stopper assembly. See Front Hatch Cover Front Door Stopper Assembly

10. Remove the right front door outer weatherstrip assembly. See Installation and Removal of Right Front Door Outer Weatherstrip Assembly

11. Remove the right front door harness. See Installation and Removal of Right Front Door Harness

![](images/5ddd9938c35c2a80bdd8d7320e8aa21b0c8701560153f1d3c8b0d94ec8431dce.webp)

Installation

12. Remove 2 fixing bolts of the right front door. Tightening torque: xxxN•m

13. Remove 2 fixing bolts, and take out the right front door assembly.

Tightening torque: xxxN•m

1. Install in the reverse order of removal.

### ? Reminder:

The removal and installation of the left front door lower hinge assembly and left front door upper hinge assembly are the same. Take the left front door upper hinge assembly as an example.

### Removal

1. Remove the left fender assembly. See Installation and Removal of Left Fender Assembly

![](images/26218f7169fb31d929607e0b004be6f05dc93127bbac828f34400b790d3c44fa.webp)

2. Remove four fixing bolts and take out the left front door upper hinge assembly. Tightening torque: 28± 2N•m

### A Caution:

When removing the hinge fixing bolt, the door must be closed completely.

Installation

A Caution:

After installing the hinge assembly, adjust the door assembly.

1. Install in the reverse order of removal.

2. Adjustment of door assembly. See Adjustment of Front Door Assembly

### ® Reminder:

The removal and installation of the lower hinge assembly of the right front door and the upper hinge assembly of the right front door are the same. Take the upper hinge assembly of the right front door as an example.

### Removal

1. Remove the right fender assembly. See Installation and Removal of Right Fender Assembly

![](images/e19a93029dffce150f905ac137275de84aa1a950320c41db06c026ae5c9f60c7.webp)

2. Remove 4 fixing bolts and take out the right front door upper hinge assembly.

Tightening torque: 28±2N•m

A Caution:

When removing the hinge fixing bolt, the door must be closed completely.

Installation

A Caution:

After installing the hinge assembly, adjust the door assembly.

1. Install in the reverse order of removal. 2. Adjustment of door assembly. See Adjustment of Front Door Assembly

2. Remove the front door sealing plug.

a. Remove the front right door sealing plug III. b. Remove the front right door sealing plug II.

![](images/a3c0bad5b6306c244af4f96f23cb4e1c5fe75c9f8447f804a5e837870f994dfc.webp)

3. Remove the outer pull rod of the front right door lock.

a. Disconnect it from the front right door handle assembly. b. Disconnect it from the front right door lock body assembly, and take out the outer pull rod of the front right door lock.

Installation

1. Install it in the reverse order of removal.

### ? Reminder:

The assembly of the left and right front doors must be adjusted in the same way. Take the left side as an example.

### ? Caution:

The door assembly side bolt has no adjustment and cannot be adjusted by loosening the door assembly side bolt.

![](images/4287e173f55b51c8d15e0d5207b1569e0de8507e1b211e88341558bd0ed21772.webp)

1. Loosen 4 fixing bolts on the left front door assembly body side. Tightening torque: 28±2N•m

![](images/fb30509c17769c6d3144cb7941358be353a42980895709298b8e951b8d0c236d.webp)

2. Adjust the left front door assembly horizontally and vertically.

![](images/be1d1ab706c8fd9b68fc5701cc79f283fada6d0fcb2a0c46828b101e9d45a823.webp)

3. Loosen 2 fixing screws on the side door lock ring and adjust the clearance surface difference of left front door assembly.

Tightening torque: 20±2N•m

### A Caution:

When removing and installing the internal parts of the door assembly, wear gloves to prevent against scratches.

Remove the door assembly with the assistance of another maintenance technician.

When removing the door exterior water cut, do not pry the exterior water cut with metal tools to prevent damage to the door paint.

When removing the door glass, lift the glass to the maintenance position in advance and then power off the low voltage system to facilitate the removal and installation of the fixing bolt.

After the door hinge is removed, the position of the door assembly must be adjusted to prevent movement interference from damaging the door.

Check whether the removed sealing plugs are complete and free from damage. Ensure that they are in place during installation to prevent the electrical parts from being damaged and the door from being rusted due to the rainwater entering the door.

Before installing the door guard, check whether all clips are lost or damaged, and replace with new ones if any. After installation, it must fit in place with the door assembly.

? Caution:

When installing the fastener, tighten the fastener to the standard torque.

### Systems Manual Overview

The door is the channel for the drivers and passengers to get in and out of the door, which can not only isolate the external interference,

but also buffer the impact force in case of collision, so as to protect the drivers and passengers.

### ? Warning:

It is strictly prohibited to decompose the tailgate gas spring, so as not to cause unnecessary damage.

### A Caution:

When removing the tailgate assembly fixing bolt, remove it with the assistance of others to prevent the tailgate assembly from slipping and causing personal injury. After removing a single tailgate gas spring, do not open the tailgate assembly to the maximum opening, which prevents the tailgate gas spring on the other side from being understressed and the sudden falling and closing of tailgate assembly causing personal injury.

### Systems Manual

Overview

The tailgate, also known as the back door or the rear door, is a movable outward body part located at the rear of a body to protect and cover the occupants or storage. It is suspended on the roof rear cross member through two hinges.

Component Position Diagram

![](images/e0857b5a21fff73b6a45a420fe76611f17f31438b74d1496968f810893aba33a.webp)

![](images/8a97d53d0ae3b8e14b1853329cc7911141de4784f71d340a1b765d01f7885c12.webp)

![](images/eb008f9e97c82a2e6e8b87e27b58a6b39ccbdabdc852000bf1867eb5f5536bf2.webp)

Specification
![](images/60402091ff40dfc9b661dda5d88a73b70ca8e13cdef91c92dec4f649635ac255.webp)

### A Caution:

Remove or install the tailgate assembly with the assistance of another maintenance
technician.
When removing and installing the tailgate assembly, be careful to avoid scratching the surface material.

### Removal

1. Power off the low voltage electrical system. See Poweroff and Poweron of Low Voltage Electrical System
2. Remove the rear spoiler assembly. See Installation and Removal of Rear Spoiler Assembly
3. Remove the tailgate lower guard assembly. See Installation and Removal of Tailgate Lower Guard Assembly
4. Remove the middle tail lamp. See Installation and Removal of Middle Tail Light
5. Remove the trunk lid switch. See Installation and Removal of Trunk Lid Switch
6. Remove the tailgate lock body assembly. See Installation and Removal of Tailgate Lock Body Assembly
7. Remove the tailgate handle. See Installation and Removal of Tailgate Handle
8. Remove the tailgate harness I. See Installation and Removal of Tailgate Harness I
9. Remove the tailgate harness II. See Installation and Removal of Tailgate Harness II
10. Remove the tailgate left gas spring door bracket. See Installation and Removal of Tailgate Left Gas Spring Door Bracket
11. Remove the tailgate right gas spring door bracket. See Installation and Removal of Tailgate Right Gas Spring Door Bracket
12. Remove the tailgate lower buffer block. See Installation and Removal of Tailgate Lower Buffer Block

13. Remove the tailgate window assembly. See Installation and Removal of Tailgate Window Assembly

14. Remove 4 fixing bolts, and take out the tailgate assembly. Tightening torque: 25±3N•m

### Adjustment of Tailgate Lower Buffer Block

1. Close the tailgate assembly. 2. Carefully check the flatness of both sides of the tailgate and body outside the vehicle, and check from the gap. 3. If it is not smooth, rotate the tailgate lower buffer block clockwise or counterclockwise in several times until it is smooth.

### ? Caution:

Take out the blinder component carefully and place it properly.
The blinder assembly needs to be initialized after it is installed.
Wear goggles and gloves to reduce the risk of injury when handling any glass
component with sharp edges or burrs.
The glass cement must be applied evenly and continuously.
When taking out the glass component, it must be removed by using a glass suction cup.
After the glass assembly is installed,
you must wait until the glass cement is
completely cured before driving.

Systems Manual Overview

This model adopts the leap curtain panoramic sunroof, the roof is completely covered by highstrength glass to provide safe and reliable quality.

Panoramic sunroof is different from ordinary sunroof. The ordinary sunroof can be opened for ventilation and panoramic sunroof is not operative. When the blinder is opened, the panoramic sunroof area is larger so as to make the inside sunroof lighting area large.

### A Caution:

– Must use the manufacturer's recommended glass cement, and misuse of glass cement will affect its own original adhesive property.
Carefully read the instructions and designations provided by the manufacturer of the glass cement used before operation, and be sure to adopt this procedure and observe all precautions throughout the operation. Cover the body with tape to prevent damage to the tailgate assembly.
If the coating surface is scratched and damaged, repair it or replace it with a new one, otherwise the damaged part will gradually expand.

1. Remove the ceiling assembly. See removal and installation of ceiling assembly

2. Remove the blinder components. See removal and installation of blinder components

3. Remove the glass seal. If the glass seal is difficult to remove, cut it off if necessary.

4. Drill a hole through the glass adhesive from the inside of the vehicle at the corner of the windshield glass with a drill, and then make the piano wire pass through it, and wrap both ends of the piano wire on the wooden block.

### A Caution:

The window sealing strip fits the body. To prevent damage to the body surface when pulling a steel wire to cut the
sealant, it is necessary to cut the edge of the sealing strip;
Cover the body with tape to prevent damage to the body.

![](images/c13bad9bfbb077bbfa07f785cf16913acda36766919aaeeb0309801a8ef8032a.webp)

5. Carefully saw the sealant of the glass component by pulling the wire along the perimeter of the glass.

![](images/5c39af7bf3c9dddee29169fcf49af59b96496135dce1df7fbff632756ab378a4.webp)

Installation

6. Take out the front windshield glass assembly.

### A Caution:

Take out with care and with the assistance of another maintenance technician.

1. Remove the adhesive agent remaining on the contact surface between the vehicle body and the glass to ensure that the surface of the vehicle body meets the requirements.

### ? Caution:

Be careful not to damage the body on its paint.
After cleaning, do not touch oil and
water.

2. Apply sufficient base agent around the glass surface to be bonded to the body, with a width of about 15 mm.

3. Apply glass cement evenly to at the installation position of the body and glass.

4. Align the clip on the inner surface of the glass with the hole on the body and press the glass into the body.

### A Caution:

After installation, make sure that the glass clings to the body completely. If the adhesive tape is not fully attached, press it with tape until the adhesive is completely bonded. If the door is closed suddenly before the adhesive is completely bonded, the glass may become loose or fall off. Do not drive the vehicle before the bonding part is fully bonded to ensure a thorough and sufficient curing. Each glass adhesive has its own curing time. Be sure to check the curing time of the used glass adhesive with reference to manufacturer s instruction, and take

### A Caution:

necessary measures before the bonding part is fully bonded.
Do not use high pressure water gun for waterproof test.
When drying, do not use the
compressed air directly to the glued
part, do not use infrared bulb or the like. After the glass cement is solidified,
the waterproof test shall be carried
out. If water seepage is found, glass
cement shall be used to fill the leakage part. After filling, if leakage can still be found, remove the glass and restart
the installation according to the above installation steps.

### ? Caution:

When removing the bumper assembly,
wear gloves to avoid scratches.
Remove and install the bumper assembly with the assistance of another maintenance technician.
Be careful not to scratch the paint of
the bumper and the vehicle body during removal.
Before removing the bumper from the body, the connector should be disconnected to prevent the connector from pulling and
damaging it.
When a slotted screwdriver is used for
levering, first wrap the screwdriver head with protective tapes to avoid scratching or damaging the bumper.
When removing the bumper clip, because the connection of the clip is relatively
tight, the clip should be carefully and
slowly pressed one by one, and cannot be removed violently.

System descriptions Overview

Bumpers are equipped on both the front and rear ends of the vehicle. They can decorate the vehicle and absorb and buffer the impact force externally applied to protect the vehicle body and passengers in the vehicle.

Component position view

![](images/924f52bdcdef10b6765151f1df5c88d8500d574cd4030af92aa5ca9d44a818b2.webp)

![](images/b72fa98270c2d85fd09a10bd338b63eeecf81342b91caa838f5a3bd0b12fa807.webp)

### Removal and installation of front bumper assembly Removal

1. Power off the low-voltage electrical system. Refer to Power-off and power-on of lowvoltage electrical system

2. Remove the front left wheel arch trim panel assembly. Refer to Installation and Removal of Left Front Wheel Eyebrow Trim Panel Assembly

3. Remove the front right wheel arch trim panel assembly. Refer to Installation and Removal of Right Front Wheel Eyebrow Trim Panel Assembly

4. Remove the front bumper upper cover. Refer to Removal and installation of front bumper upper cover

![](images/af682c606a149ac05074e4813c6f71ee0186d4600f401165b4989a2a4e256873.webp)

5. Remove 4 fixing bolts of the front bumper assembly. Tightening torque: 3±0.5 N•m

![](images/45a0819fcb613799974b05985421273346eebd65d39df935836f390f4cd4dc79.webp)

6. Remove 4 fixing screws on the left side of front bumper assembly.

![](images/46a4a613e1796cd0042f3fc7939a727ab5bec0071ae0db4ea0e00dfca3d83073.webp)

7. Remove 4 fixing screws on the right side of front bumper assembly.

![](images/8ab13ac8b24fa2da0130a3d156dc4564a00ef7a4d6375f3381d76b64baadbe10.webp)

8. Remove the front bumper assembly. a. Remove 6 fixing screws. b. Remove 2 fixing bolts. Tightening torque: 3±0.5 N•m c. Remove 4 fixing bolts. Tightening torque: 3±0.5 N•m

![](images/6b7b6effaf88c3b51d2662b550159f771b8608a0fcf385787720a3920b34d21d.webp)

9. Detach the front bumper assembly.

? Caution:

Do not exert excessive force when detaching the bumper assembly to prevent the connector being damaged.

![](images/1bd06b7ec9f1b8d52f047d2ba134c73a630371c29ef846c5f1b3265af81f54c6.webp)

10. Detach the front bumper. a. Disconnect 2 connectors. b. Detach 1 wiring harness clip.

![](images/69a5b927ac483fae4964c2e03b7bddd62458301a982626a3d2c8c29ce6800e17.webp)

Installation

11. Disconnect 】 connector of the front middle position light.

12. Take out the front bumper assembly.

1. Install it in the reverse order of removal.

8. Remove the small probe. Refer to Removal and installation of small probes
9. Remove the front bumper wire. Refer to Removal and installation of front bumper wire
10. Remove the front-view panoramic image module. Refer to Removal and installation of panoramic front-view image module
11. Remove the front bumper lower body. Refer to Removal and installation of front bumper lower body

![](images/90c081ba8b4678c0b21d936d8fb0572b9c8cff50905dfe709716d15c97f9a02b.webp)

12. Take out the front bumper upper body.

Installation

1. Install it in the reverse order of removal.

![](images/10e0d5170614b723a9e292dc37cde9c0d082ba22cf67ad2c1175ec2a04af52eb.webp)

Installation

### Reminder:

The removal and installation of the left and right rear air vent assemblies are the same. Take the left side as an example below.

a. Press the pins with a slotted screwdriver to pry the rear bumper vent out of the body sheet metal. b. Take out the rear air vent assembly.

Installation

### A Caution:

Before installation, check whether the pins are damaged, and replace the rear air vent if damaged. After installation, check whether there is any gap around the air vent that does not fit, ensure that the air vent is installed in place, and avoid affecting the dust and waterproof performance.

1. Install in the reverse order of removal.

### Removal and installation of instrument panel upper body assembly Removal

1. Remove the left A-pillar upper shield assembly. Refer to Installation and Removal of Left A-Pillar Upper Guard Assembly
2. Remove the right A-pillar upper shield assembly. Refer to Installation and Removal of Right A-Pillar Upper Guard Assembly

7. Remove the display screen bracket assembly. Refer to Removal and installation of display screen bracket assembly
8. Remove the instrument panel cluster assembly. Refer to Removal and installation of instrument panel cluster assembly
9. Remove the steering wheel assembly. Refer to Removal and installation of steering wheel assembly
10. Remove 3 fixing screws on the left side of instrument panel upper body assembly.

1. Power off the low voltage electrical system. See Power-off and Power-on of Low Voltage Electrical System

![](images/80994d496c2b1def6ace141a321cb1ac977d75e0ae5f5277daf6854a88e0ae5e.webp)

2. Pry out the console front shielding plate assembly.

![](images/e7d005e7ad7fb4d4e14c66c23bad0dc0553c9343e80dca9672bf339534ed1567.webp)

3. Disconnect 2 connector and take out the console front shielding plate assembly.

4. Remove the console armrest assembly. See Installation and Removal of Console Armrest Assembly

![](images/4d528202a4be736d1de95a109c555feaf55fc36fce67cfc023a41882f9521b2d.webp)

5. Use a plastic crow plate to carefully pry out the console cup holder assembly.

6. Disconnect 3 connectors and take out the console cup holder assembly.

7. To replace the console cup holder assembly, remove the following accessories from it:

EPB switch See Installation and Removal of EPB Switch
Wireless charging module. See Installation and Removal of Wireless Charging Module Interior detection antenna assembly.
See Removal and Installation of Interior Detection Antenna (Located in the Console Cup Holder Assembly)

Installation

### A Caution:

Before installation, check whether the clips are missing or damaged. If so, install new clips, and then install the console cup holder assembly.

### A Caution:

– After installation, check whether all clips are installed in place. The installation position of the console cup holder assembly may deviate, resulting in warping or abnormal gaps.

1. Install in the reverse order of removal.

### System descriptions Overview

Side mirrors allow the driver, while sitting in the driver s seat, to get a clear view of areas behind and to the sides of the vehicle, as well as lower areas on both sides. This minimizes the risk of accidents and ensures personal safety.

The lens and assembly of the side mirror are adjusted through the electric adjustment switch. The adjustment function varies with the model configuration. Before maintenance, it is necessary to confirm the vehicle configuration first.

The electric side mirror has the following functions:

Leveling of mirror Vertical adjustment of mirror Electric defrosting Component position view

System descriptions Overview

The model is equipped with driver's manual seat or power seat according to different configurations, both supporting six-way adjustment and of integrated multi-color sport style.

Removal and installation of driver's seat assembly (power) Removal

1. Remove the lower anchorage end cover of the driver's seat belt. Refer to Removal and installation of lower anchorage end cover of driver's seat belt (electric)

![](images/f13f4979120d79b98a0d74661e360c9a809f4255d5fcfe71c17f59b6f7f3ad2c.webp)

2. Remove 1 fixing bolt of the driver's seat assembly.

Tightening torque: 45±5 N•m

![](images/61fedb4601a09d4a00242d065c83a77e202fdf8e1b6364501d1c6363a6085c2c.webp)

3. Remove 2 fixing bolts at the front of the driver's seat assembly.

Tightening torque: 45±5 N•m

A Caution:

Before removing the front fixing bolt of the seat assembly, the seat assembly must be adjusted to the rearmost position.

![](images/16c364aebf21c91290e5ab10b072d4fde82f66bf7426eadfe4e86bbb25c97db2.webp)

4. Remove 2 fixing bolts at the rear of driver's seat assembly.

Tightening torque: 45±5 N•m

A Caution:

Please adjust the seat assembly to the front end before removing the fixing bolt at the rear of the seat assembly.

5. Power off the low-voltage electrical system. Refer to Power-off and power-on of lowvoltage electrical system

![](images/be7a81fedefd875a4684db9a1407f767b1659bc99111776f9378f93bd23a39af.webp)

6. Detach the floor wiring harness from the driver's seat assembly. a. Detach 1 wiring harness clip. b. Disconnect 3 connectors.

![](images/bb7fcca703ac0aaea42d32eb1a217e702c2813ea30f02334ab7450b2d345f015.webp)

7. Take out the driver's seat assembly.

### ? Caution:

Take out the seat assembly with the assistance of another maintenance technician. Never scratch the body guards when taking out the seat assembly.

Installation

### ? Caution:

After the electric seat assembly is installed, operate the seat adjustment button to check whether the seat assembly can work normally.

1. Install it in the reverse order of removal.

3. Remove 1 fixing bolt of the front passenger's seat assembly.

![](images/df308ae05b84612a4e44f374e495f4a07df974c9c5a70d2b2a5692f4034c1b58.webp)

4. Remove 2 fixing bolts at the front of the front passenger's seat assembly.

Tightening torque: 45±5 N•m

A Caution:

Before removing the front fixing bolt of the seat assembly, the seat assembly must be adjusted to the rearmost position.

![](images/4e64c12db53bf708b1a177ce3ec80b8e2a027e630e5149473694f6b1a9e58c22.webp)

5. Remove 2 fixing bolts at the rear of the front passenger's seat assembly.

Tightening torque: 45±5 N•m

A Caution:

Please adjust the seat assembly to the front end before removing the fixing bolt at the rear of the seat assembly.

![](images/1d9d446d9c84a0b73a2205da21e7df8f222c903a2856c9f1062f4b05aae48dad.webp)

6. Detach the floor wiring harness from the front passenger's seat assembly. a. Detach wiring harness clip. b. Disconnect 3 connectors.

![](images/24019ce28bf5ef4a3e2f10c5a3e031acb30e09a27bc53f2bf9cbe4475e867e1e.webp)

7. Take out the front passenger's seat assembly.

### A Caution:

When taking out the seat assembly, do not move the seat slide rail to avoid dislocation and affect the installation of the seat assembly.
Take out the seat assembly with the assistance of another maintenance technician.
Never scratch the body guards when taking out the seat assembly.

1. Install it in the reverse order of removal.

### Removal and installation of front passenger's seat assembly (doublepretensioner seat belt)

Removal

1. Open the front and rear doors.

![](images/1b039d59c15fd8e5797979a35f53c4ede3d483654de559885c9097b1ea7ccda5.webp)

2. Insert 2 miniature straight screwdrivers into 2 unlocking holes, and at the same time, forcibly open 2 unlocking devices and detach the lower buckles of the seat belt upwards.

i Reminder:

Two persons are required to perform this step.

![](images/fb3fb52107f0f97e9c9146c2ad226e86c9a02ae3055b19cd40799b2b8f1a20d0.webp)

3. Remove 2 fixing bolts at the front of the front passenger's seat assembly.

Tightening torque: 45±5 N•m

? Caution:

Before removing the front fixing bolt of the seat assembly, the seat assembly must be adjusted to the rearmost position.

![](images/2bd4658953dab5e990e119e5dda02ef9a56f11362b52ba87ec571f7019fe5f30.webp)

4. Remove 2 fixing bolts at the rear of the front passenger's seat assembly.

Tightening torque: 45±5 N•m

A Caution:

Please adjust the seat assembly to the front end before removing the fixing bolt at the rear of the seat assembly.

![](images/ea87743efcc58d3ff13dc718561ef296813635aee299b20521d9ed08169643d2.webp)

![](images/cee952896c6343fb99fcdbc7ebd8f1ebedc4130c7b6accade9c7513ea3aa4d86.webp)

5. Detach the floor wiring harness from the front passenger's seat assembly. a. Detach wiring harness clip. b. Disconnect 3 connectors.

6. Take out the front passenger's seat assembly.

### A Caution:

When taking out the seat assembly, do not move the seat slide rail to avoid dislocation and affect the installation of the seat assembly.
Take out the seat assembly with the assistance of another maintenance technician.
Never scratch the body guards when taking out the seat assembly.

1. Install it in the reverse order of removal.

### A Caution:

Wear gloves when removing the door
guard to avoid scratches.
Remove the trim panel with plastic or
equivalent material tools.
Be careful when removing the trim panel to avoid scratching the surface material.
Do not apply excessive force when
removing the door guard assembly to
prevent damage to the connector.
Before installation, check whether all clips are missing or damaged, if so, install a new clip, and then install the trim panel.
After installation, check whether all clips are installed in place. The installation
position of the trim panel may deviate,
resulting in warping or abnormal gaps.
Ensure that the inner release cable is
connected correctly and the harness is connected correctly. Check whether the windows, power door locks and electrical components function normally.

### ? Caution:

After installing the door frame seal, check whether it is installed in place, otherwise it will affect the sealing performance.

### ? Warning:

Before maintenance, carefully read the precautions related to the airbag module.

Before maintenance, turn off the ignition switch, disconnect the negative terminal of 12 V battery for more than 3 min, and release static electricity.

Operate on the side of the airbag instead of on the front.

Be sure to check all seat belt assemblies after any collision. Replace the seat belt assembly with a new one unless a qualified professional technician confirms that the assembly can work normally without damage. In addition, check the seat belt assembly not used during the collision, and replace it with a new one if it is damaged. Installing a new seat belt assembly using an incorrect installation procedure may increase the risk of personal injury during a collision.

The seat belt pretensioner is a pyrotechnic device. Always wear goggles when repairing a seat belt equipped with a pretensioner. Do not probe the electrical terminals of a pretensioner, as this operation may deploy the pretensioner or airbag and cause personal injury. Failure to follow the correct operation will result in accidental deployment of airbags and failure of safety protection devices when necessary.

### ? Caution:

Connect the seat belt with the retractor and buckle normally.
Keep sharp and destructive objects away from the seat belt.
Do not bleach or dye the seat belt (clean it only with neutral soap and warm water). When installing the seat belt, pre-tighten the screw by hand to avoid slipping.
Do not attempt to repair the retractor
or its cover. Replace the non-functioning assembly with a new one.
Keep the seat belt dry and clean.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> – Replace the seat belt that has been cut or damaged. Do not fill anything into the trim panel hole through which the seat belt passes. When disconnecting the seat belt connector, insert a small screwdriver wrapped with adhesive tape into the slot of the connector to pry up the buckle, and then remove the connector. - After installing the seat belt connector, check whether the buckle has been fully pressed in.
> – After installing the seat belt connector, check whether the buckle has been fully pressed in. After removing fasteners, be sure to put
> them back in place. If a fastener needs to be replaced, use the fastener with the same part number. If a fastener with the same part number cannot be found, use one of the same size and strength (or higher). Remove any fastener, which cannot be reused or requires thread locking, from the vehicle. For fasteners requiring a specified tightening torque, tighten them to the specified torque during reinstallation. Failure to comply with the above requirements may result in damage to components or systems.
> – Seat belts and their accessories can affect the main components and systems of the vehicle. Therefore, they must be carefully inspected and replaced with original parts.
>
> Do not use the pretensioner (retractor) that has been triggered, but replace it in the form of an assembly.

### Systems Manual Overview

The front seat belt pretensioner is designed to fasten the seat belt when activated. In the case of frontal and near-frontal collisions, the seat belt pretensioner may be only activated. In the case of very serious collision, the pretensioner will be activated together with the frontal airbag. The pretensioner is also activated when the side air curtain is deployed.

A seat belt is a safety protection device to protect drivers and passengers, which is used in conjunction with airbags. Airbags cannot replace seat belts. Drivers and passengers must always fasten their seat belt and adjust themselves to the most appropriate condition.

The seat belt is intended to restrain the occupants in the event of a collision and to prevent the occupants from colliding with the steering wheel and instrument panel or from rushing out of the seat belt and causing death or injury. A vehicle seat belt can also be called a seat belt, as a kind of occupant restraint. A seat belt is recognized as the most effective safety device.

The seat belt system mainly consists of the following parts:

Seat belt

All seating positions use three-point seat belts, with a pre-tensioner seat belt in the front and a conventional seat belt in the rear. In order to protect the safety of the rear middle passengers, the vehicle is equipped with the rear middle seat belt.

### Seat belt buckle

The seat belt buckle and the seat belt together form a passenger protection device. A seat belt alarm light switch is integrated in the driver's seat belt buckle. When the driver does not fasten the seat belt during driving, the seat belt alarm light the instrument will be kept on to remind the driver to fasten the seat belt to protect the driving safety of drivers.

### Systems Manual

Overview

The mudguard is installed under the wheels to block the mud and sand, keep the body clean and protect the paint from damage.

Component Position Diagram

![](images/5054f3d93c18c053725511c2b0f1f411de1f9e303dc084f3944a678808793156.webp)

![](images/6ff55eefadbc743ca8041e96c3802cb1697c1f50e97bd4846abd186659ca5d0a.webp)

Specification
![](images/28a87df07be1728e34f652ea280913d3dae9436a3268fcc36cfd5133834ddab4.webp)

### Installation

1. Lift the vehicle See “Lift the vehicle”

2. Remove the front subframe mudguard assembly. a. Remove 2 fixing clips. b. Remove the 8 fixing screws. c. Remove 12 fixing bolts and take out the front subframe mudguard assembly. Tightening torque: xxxN•m

1. Install in the reverse order of removal.

### Installation and Removal of Left Front Wheel Mudguard Assembly Removal

### Systems Manual

Overview

Ceiling assembly

It is installed on the roof and wrapped with the roof sheet metal, which can effectively isolate the heat and noise from the outside and provide a comfortable environment for the interior of the vehicle.

Sun visor assembly

Turn over the sun visor assembly to protect your eyes from sunlight when driving or sitting on the front passenger seat.

Glass box assembly

Glasses and other small items can be stored.

Roof handle assembly

The roof handles are installed above the seat assembly of the right front, left rear and right rear seats. It is designed for the occupants. When the vehicle is driving on the uneven road, the body jumps, the seat belt alone can't fix the occupants firmly on the seat, thus reducing the ride comfort. The occupants can keep their body balanced by grasping the roof handle.

7. Remove the left front noise reduction MIC. See Removal and Installation of Left Front Noise Reduction MIC
8. Remove the right front noise reduction MIC. See Removal and Installation of Left Front Noise Reduction MIC
9. Remove the left A-pillar upper guard assembly. See Installation and Removal of Left A-Pillar Upper Guard Assembly
10. Remove the right A-pillar upper guard assembly. See Installation and Removal of Right A-Pillar Upper Guard Assembly
11. Remove the left B-pillar upper guard assembly. See Installation and Removal of Left B-Pillar Upper Guard Assembly

### ? Caution:

When servicing the airbag system, failure to follow the correct operation procedure may result in serious injury due to accidental airbag deployment. Besides, incorrect service operation may result in deployment failure when deployment conditions are fulfilled. Therefore, before servicing the airbag system, be sure to read the precautions for the airbag system carefully and observe the correct operation procedure.

The safety protection system (SRS) can still work for a period of time after the power is disconnected. Wait at least 3 minutes before disassembling or removing any safety protection system (SRS) components.

Ensure that the electrical system is completely de-energized and no other power supply is connected before the removal and installation of the airbag system.

When installing the SRS electronic control unit, install it in the correct direction to ensure it functions properly. Before installation, check for cracks, deformation and rust.

If airbag or SRS electronic control unit falls down to the ground or has been subjected to vibration or strikes, or if there is any crack, dent or damage on the casing, bracket or connector, replace with a new part.

After a minor impact, be sure to check the airbag system even if airbags have not been deployed.

There are warning labels attached to the airbag components and related position in the vehicle compartment. Be sure to observe the warnings when performing any specific operation.

If the vehicle may be subjected to vibration during any repair to other systems or components, remove the SRS electronic control unit before the repair begins.

### ? Caution:

When unfavorable effect may be caused by overheating due to painting operation, remove the SRS electronic control unit, PAB or clock spring before operation and keep them properly.

The airbag system must be installed immediately after removed from a transport container during airbag module repairing. if a suspension is required, such module must be put back in the container rather than being unattended. The airbag module removed must be placed with the buffer facing up.

Do not use a test lamp or ordinary voltmeter and ohmmeter to perform airbag testing; high-impedance voltmeters and ohmmeters must be used (at least 10 kΩ/V).

Allow the system to perform self-diagnosis before and after any replacement of airbag component, checking if the system is normal.

Replace the instrument panel if it is damaged after airbag deployment.

The SRS electronic control unit connector, clock spring connector and PAB connector all have a protection mechanism against accidental airbag deployment.

After servicing the airbag system, do not connect the airbag module to the circuit before electrical inspection. First verify everything is ok, and then connect the airbag module.

An airbag inflator unit contains sodium azide and potassium nitrate. These materials are poisonous and extremely flammable. Contact with acid, water, or heavy metals may produce harmful and irritating gases (sodium hydroxide is formed in the presence of moisture) or combustible compounds. An airbag inflator unit may also contain pressurized argon. Do not attempt to dismantle an airbag unit or damage its inflator. Do not puncture, incinerate, or bring into contact with electricity. Do not store at temperatures exceeding 93℃.

### 1 Warning:

Never use any airbag component removed from other vehicles. Replace with a new one as necessary.
Do not disassemble and repair the
component of airbag system for reuse or any other reason.
Do not position the airbag or SRS
electronic control unit in hot air or flames. The airbags have a normal service life
of 10 years. Do not use the airbag and
replace the airbag and labels after the
service life has been reached.
Be sure to disconnect the airbag system before performing welding operation on any position of the vehicle; otherwise,
accidental airbag deployment may occur. Never test any circuit of the airbag system using an electrical tester.

### System descriptions Overview

There are active and passive safety systems in vehicles. Active safety means the ability to identify dangers in advance (e.g., windshield vision, lighting system, mirrors, etc.) and to avoid dangers in advance (e.g., steering system, brake system, driving antiskid system, and vehicle body stability control system). Passive safety means to avoid or reduce the harm to the occupants, such as seat belts and airbags.

The supplemental restraint system (SRS) is a passive and deployable supplemental protective system. A vehicle equipped with this system can be quickly identified by the SRS or AIRBAG mark.

The driver airbag mark is cast on the trim cover in the middle of the steering wheel, while the passenger airbag mark is cast on the instrument panel. A vehicle equipped with SRS can also be identified by the SRS MIL on the instrument panel cluster. Each time when the power supply is turned to the ON position for system self-test, the SRS MIL on the instrument panel cluster will illuminate for about 3s.

Composition of SRS:

Front collision sensor I
Side collision sensor
SRS MIL
SRS electronic control unit
Clock spring
Driver airbag module
Front passenger airbag module
Side curtain airbag module
Seat belt reminder sensor

The SRS ECU is installed on the central axis of the vehicle, below the auxiliary instrument panel body. If the voltage of the 12 V battery is too low or the power supply is cut off due to collision, the SRS ECU can still continue to work for more than 100 ms.

The driver airbag is installed in the steering wheel central trim cover and cannot be disassembled. It consists of gas generator, air bag, trim cover, bracket and other auxiliaries. The function of the driver airbag is to receive ignition signal from the SRS ECU and ignite the gas generator to generate a large amount of gas to inflate the air bag and form an air cushion for protecting the driver.

The clock spring is installed on the multifunction switch and composed of spiral cable, rotor, shell, wiring harness and auxiliary structural parts. When the steering wheel is turned, the rotor and steering wheel rotate as a whole and the spiral cable with sufficient length is coiled in the shell spirally so that it will not affect the reliable connection of the wire when the rotor rotates by 2.5 turns clockwise or counterclockwise from the middle position.

The front passenger airbag module is installed inside the instrument panel and above the instrument panel body, with the same function as that of the driver airbag module.

The front left and right collision sensors are installed inside the left and right water tank pillars. They are designed to transmit a collision signal to the SRS ECU as the basis for the SRS ECU to determine whether an ignition signal or a collision unlocking signal needs to be sent.

Airbag wiring harness are used to connect SRS ECU, driver airbag module, front passenger airbag module, side curtain airbag modules, clock spring and instrument panel wiring harness. The airbag wiring harness consists of airbag module drive circuit, MIL circuit, collision unlocking circuit and vehicle communication bus. They are used to communicate signals between the SRS ECU and the airbag module as well as the vehicle and to ensure reliable communication. The airbag circuit wiring harness can be identified by its special color (yellow) cable or plug.

### System descriptions Overview

The SRS MIL is located on the instrument panel cluster and will illuminate for informing the driver of a fault in the SRS in case of any fault identified by the SRS ECU self-diagnosis circuit. Under normal circumstances, when the vehicle is powered ON, the MIL will illuminate for about 3s and then go out.

Components that assist the SRS:

Lower left shield of instrument panel: It is a molded structural part located at the rear side of the steering column opening cover and integrated with the instrument panel to protect the driver's knee from collision.

Seat belt: In case of emergency braking, collision or rollover, it firmly restrains the driver and the passenger on the seats to limit their position, so as to avoid or reduce the damage to them caused by the secondary collision due to inertia force.

Seat belt buckle with reminder assembly: It monitors whether the driver and passengers fasten seat belts.

Child safety lock: When provided, the rear passengers cannot open the doors in the vehicle, thus avoiding the danger of accidental opening by children and sudden opening during vehicle collision.

Anti-collision energy-absorbing vehicle body and accessories: They include bumper assembly, door assembly and bumper beam.

The working of airbag depends on the angle and severity of vehicle collision. The collision angle specified to activate the SRS is within 30° in front of the body centerline. The deployment of an airbag does not depend on the vehicle speed but on the deceleration ratio measured by gravity (KG) and this force is measured by the collision sensor in SRS ECU. When a frontal collision is serious enough, the microprocessor in the SRS ECU will send a working signal to the deployment device of the 2 airbag modules to make the airbag deploy. The clock spring at the top of the steering column allows a continuous circuit to be maintained between the fixed steering column and the driver airbag expander, which can also rotate with the steering wheel. When the vehicle suffers a frontal collision and the airbags deploy, the lower left shield of the instrument panel works together with the seat belts to restrain the driver and front passenger in place. The lower left shield of the instrument panel can also absorb and disperse the impact energy of the driver and front passenger acting on the instrument panel structure. When the SRS ECU detects a fault in any airbag component or SRS circuit, it stores a corresponding DTC in its memory and sends a message to the instrument panel cluster to illuminate the SRS MIL. The VDS is needed to properly test the

SRS components, read or clear DTCs, and perform maintenance.
